summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @servicetitan/standalone-root@1.11.6 ships a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime (`bun-v1.3.13`) from GitHub releases and uses `execFileSync` to run a sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~720 KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (rotated string-array + hex-encoded identifiers). The package's declared purpose is React data providers for Standalone MFEs, which has no need for a second JavaScript runtime or an opaque bundled payload. `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with hex-named identifiers and indirection-object wrappers to conceal the download-and-execute flow. The preinstall hook fires automatically on every `npm install`, executing the obfuscated payload with the installer's privileges before any consumer code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
